answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in oasis and gale lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the willow graph. Verification costs 5 dollars and 4 days per identity, which turns a 2439 account sybil into a 7 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
